::: {#hero-heading}

Energy is the thread that connects CO2 emissions, noise, air pollution, cost of living and road safety.
Active Analytics is an independent consultancy specialising in reproducible and transparent 
analysis of the data behind this. From dispersion modelling and meteorological data processing to publication standard and
interactive plots and simple dissemination websites.

[Learn more about what we do &rarr;](services.qmd)

:::
